title: Near copy of bank zeros
statement: How many zeros does $3025!$ end with?
hints: Name the units digit, since the tens digit depends on it.
Use the place value of each digit to list the options: the tens digit is at most $9$, which limits the units digit.
solution: The power of $5$ in $3025!$ is $605 + 121 + 24 + 4 = 754$, and there are more $2$s than $5$s, so there are $754$ zeros. Why this works. place-value-representation: the tens digit is at most nine, which limits the units digit.
check_program:
from math import factorial
s = str(factorial(3025))
print(len(s) - len(s.rstrip('0')))
